source: Binance public hourly spot archives; research only
source_warning: Cross-venue data cannot verify OKX Singapore execution
rule_selection: Require positive development and validation net returns, validation drawdown above -10%, and >=20 combined completed exits; rank by validation return. If none qualifies, evaluate the top validation candidate with >=20 combined exits and >=1 validation exit diagnostically and forbid promotion.

ml_filter.label: positive seven-day return after modeled round-trip cost
ml_filter.behavior: filters entries only; base regime controls exits
ml_filter.selection: On 2022 validation require positive return, drawdown above -10%, and >=10 exits; rank by validation return.

evaluation_refits: Annual at UTC year boundary using prior three years only
qualification: Positive net and doubled-cost result, drawdown below 10%, >=52 complete Singapore weeks, >=100 exits, positive lower 95% four-week block-bootstrap mean; then 12 forward weeks and 30 exits.
limitations: All dates are retrospective and do not replace prospective evidence.
Vendor history may be revised; missing hours remain explicit in features.
Historical bid/ask and depth are unavailable; fills are modeled.
